script.onScreen: For a season that feels dark. / One ayah. One lesson.

REFLECTION / The lesson / The surah opens with morning light and night, then reassures the Prophet ﷺ that his Lord has not left him. Later it recalls how he was cared for. On a dark day, remembering how you were carried before can steady the heart.
LIVE IT TODAY / Write down three times you were helped through · Thank Allah for each one · Ask Him for today's need
Look back. Then look up. / Save this for a difficult day

caption:
For a season that feels dark.

Surah Ad-Duha, ayat 1–3, and later in the surah, 6–8: remembering how the Prophet ﷺ was cared for.

Swipe for the ayat and one practice: look back, then look up.

Save this reminder for a difficult day.
